name: Tom Hanks
hook: America's everyman, with a filmography Jeopardy mines for Oscar roles and one volleyball.

facts.label: Forrest Gump
facts.statement: Forrest Gump (1994) has a theme nicknamed "The Feather Theme," and Forrest's friend Bubba lectures him on shrimp.

facts.label: Philadelphia
facts.statement: In Philadelphia (1993) Hanks plays Andrew Beckett, a lawyer with AIDS; Bruce Springsteen's "Streets of Philadelphia" won the Oscar for its song.

facts.label: Big
facts.statement: In Big (1988) Hanks plays a 12-year-old in a grown-up body and sings "The Way We Were"; the script was co-written by Steven Spielberg's sister Anne.

facts.label: Cast Away
facts.statement: Cast Away (2000) casts Hanks as FedEx employee Chuck Noland, stranded with a volleyball named Wilson; filming made Fiji's Monuriki a tourist draw.

facts.label: Sleepless in Seattle
facts.statement: Sleepless in Seattle (1993) ends with Hanks and Meg Ryan meeting atop the Empire State Building.

facts.label: Saving Private Ryan
facts.statement: Saving Private Ryan (1998) put Hanks and his squad through a week of boot camp for its WWII story; Steven Spielberg won Best Director.

facts.label: Bosom Buddies
facts.statement: His 1980s sitcom Bosom Buddies had Hanks and Peter Scolari posing as Hildegarde and Buffy to live in a women's hotel.
